direction.situation: A wet Colombo roadside a moment after Kasun handed Anudi her phone back; the incoming call suddenly interrupts the small, warm exchange and becomes the visual focus.
direction.people: Anudi (only her right hand and the cream sleeve enter frame, holding the phone steady; her posture is attentive and slightly unsettled as she reads the screen).

flow.text: 0–1s: The incoming-call display fills most of the frame; the English caller ID Father is clearly readable. Anudi's right fingers support the phone without touching the screen; the phone vibrates and the ring is audible.

1–3s: Her hand settles from a small tremor into a steady hold as the display stays lit and the ring continues; the phone draws her attention away from the returned-phone moment toward the caller name.

3–4s: Hold the readable screen; her thumb rests along the phone's side while the incoming ring continues. The phone remains below her face, rain on metal and the blurred three-wheeler in the background.

direction.camera: ECU of the phone and Anudi's right hand only, high oblique from the roadside with a locked-off 100mm macro lens.
direction.sound: continuous light rain and soft road wash; incoming phone ring (continuous). no music
